fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and strike it for 16 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Trample Lane
fusions.desc: Tramples every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 30 damage to each, and every hit is a critical hit. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Heavy Going
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4s after you use it.

fusions.name: Weight of Miles
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
